wispr_fov_model.note: edges from the WISPR Data Users Guide v5 (13.5 deg sunward edge, 108.5 deg outer, 3 deg overlap, 40/58 deg fields); ram side and half-heights from Vourlidas+2016 — recon header-verification items

earth_comparison.note: PSP crosses each axis twice per 88-150 d orbit at heliocentric radii 0.05-0.7 AU; Earth-center events (annual, 1 AU) are a different population — nearest-in-time pairs are coincidences, not corrections. The PSP list is mandatory
